newsitem.title: UK: Italy refiner cuts runs 10 pct due margins-trade.
newsitem.headline: Italy refiner cuts runs 10 pct due margins-trade.

text.p: Italy's ISAB SpA has cut crude throughput by around 10 percent or 23,000 barrels per day (bpd) at its Sicily refinery due to deteriorating margins, traders said.
Throughput at the Melilli refinery may well be cut further in August in a further effort to rescue earnings, they said.
The crude runs decided on around July 9 are aimed at producing an average monthly level of 900,000 tonnes in July from the normal monthly level of one million tonnes, they said.
The crude cuts have resulted in an 80,000 tonne reduction in average monthly gas oil output during July to between 360,000 to 370,000 tonnes. The reduction is equivalent to around 20,000 bpd.
Normal gas oil production is around 440,000 tonnes.

If the cuts contemplated by ISAB are implemented in August then the Mediterranean physical distillates market will have been reduced by a total of up to 12 gas oil cargoes in July and August, the trader said.
